panels.title: Admission API metric contract
panels.description: Exact versioned decision-counter and histogram inventory across every desired API replica.

panels.title: Admission API target
panels.description: Replica-aware external admission API scrape health aggregated without Pod identity.

panels.title: Audit and outbox drift
panels.description: Bounded divergence counts split only by the fixed reconciliation kind allowlist.

panels.title: Consecutive backlogged sweeps
panels.description: Successful sweep outcomes retaining backlog, saturated at two for bounded alert state.

panels.title: Decision volume
panels.description: Five-minute external API decision count used as the latency and availability sample guard.

panels.title: Decision latency objective
panels.description: Exact five-minute fraction of qualified decisions completing within one hundred milliseconds.

panels.title: Decision latency p99
panels.description: Diagnostic five-minute p99 latency split only by the bounded operation allowlist.

panels.title: Expiration backlog
panels.description: Replica maximum; 0 through 1000 are exact and 1001 is the explicit at-least-1001 overflow sentinel.

panels.title: Expiration probe age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful bounded expiration backlog sample.

panels.title: Oldest expired reservation
panels.description: Age of the oldest reservation that is expired but remains reserved.

panels.title: Fast error-budget burn
panels.description: Minimum of the five-minute and one-hour burn rates, so both governed windows must breach.

panels.title: Lineage probe age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful bounded audit and outbox reconciliation sample.

panels.title: Maintenance metric contract
panels.description: Exact versioned scalar, drift-kind, and probe inventory across every desired maintenance replica.

panels.title: Maintenance target
panels.description: Replica-aware maintenance scrape health aggregated without Pod identity.

panels.title: Slow error-budget burn
panels.description: Minimum of the thirty-minute and six-hour burn rates, so both governed windows must breach.

panels.title: Snapshot outcome
panels.description: Fail-closed sampler outcome across replicas, split only by expiration and lineage probe.

panels.title: Successful sweep age
panels.description: Seconds since the latest successful bounded reservation expiration sweep.
